hero.name: Nick Nikolaenko
hero.description: 4+ years in frontend development. Designed architecture for two production tolling systems built from scratch. React, TypeScript, real-time systems, and performance optimization.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Frontend engineer with experience building complex dispatcher systems and enterprise interfaces from scratch. Working with real-time data, Canvas performance optimization, and architectural decisions.

project1.title: Toll Booth Dispatcher Workstation
project1.location: Eastern Exit from Ufa to M-5 "Ural" Highway
project1.description: Toll plaza operations console built as the sole frontend developer. Real-time monitoring of barriers, traffic signals, cameras, promotions, and toll pricing.
project1.highlights: REST snapshots + StompJS real-time events. Connection monitoring, auto-recovery, and resync. Up to 8 concurrent MJPEG camera streams.

project2.title: Contactless Toll Point Dispatcher Workstation
project2.location: Vitebskaya Junction of Western High-Speed Diameter
project2.description: Contactless tolling console. Real-time passage display and transaction matching that combines camera photos with transponder data.
project2.highlights: Architected the app foundation. Socket.io for live passages, drag-and-drop transaction matching, REST API integration.

project3.title: ATMS Dispatcher Workstation
project3.location: Vitebskaya Junction of Western High-Speed Diameter
project3.description: Automated Traffic Management System. Interactive map with equipment visualization via Canvas API.
project3.highlights: Reduced LCP by 55% (~4.4s → 2.0s) and INP by 57% (~470ms → 200ms). Canvas optimization, state caching, redraw throttling

project4.title: BugBounty.ru Platform
project4.description: Landing page on Next.js and admin panel for bug hunters and companies. Full development cycle: desktop and mobile versions, error handling, modals, Markdown support.
project4.highlights: Next.js + TypeScript (landing), React + Redux Toolkit (admin panel), React Hook Form, safe Markdown rendering, component optimization with useMemo/memo/useCallback

project5.title: Smart Household — AI Family Planning Assistant
project5.description: Mobile-first PWA for family tasks, calendars, offline workflows, and AI-generated plans. TypeScript monorepo with user app, admin panel, API, and background worker.
project5.highlights: React, RTK Query, React Hook Form, Zod, IndexedDB, PWA. AI provider abstraction with OpenAI-compatible API. Cursor Agents, GitHub/Figma MCP, automation scripts.
